title: Integrated Microfluidic Synthesis of Aptamer Functionalized Biozeolitic Imidazolate Framework (BioZIF-8) Targeting Lymph Node and Tumor

nodes.label: Vigorous double-spiral micromixing should give smaller, more narrowly sized ZIF-8 than hydrothermal batch synthesis

requires_unseen: F3 linked text: spiral mixing is ~46% faster than a straight channel and yields size-controlled small particles

nodes.label: One-pass co-injection during the fast microfluidic assembly should encapsulate more biomolecule than hydrothermal batch synthesis

nodes.label: Make ZIF-8 in a double-spiral microfluidic chip instead of the conventional hydrothermal batch route

attrs.conditions_from_text: two inlets, 1200 um x 60 um channel, 35 uL/min, room temperature (F3 linked text)

nodes.label: Comparison axis: microfluidic versus hydrothermal synthesis, for neat ZIF-8 and for siRNA-, DOX- and BSA-loaded ZIF-8
Coat the biomolecule-loaded ZIF-8 with a DNA (anti-CCL21) or RNA (A10) aptamer to add target recognition
Zn(NO3)2 and 2-methylimidazole streams meet in the double-spiral channel and assemble into ZIF-8 at room temperature

injection flow rate 35 uL/min (F3 linked text)

nodes.label: Cargo co-injected with the Zn stream (siRNA, DOX) or the 2-MeIM stream (BSA) is encapsulated as the crystals assemble in one pass

nodes.label: Microfluidic ZIF-8 crystals are ~350-400 nm and narrowly sized; hydrothermal crystals are ~900-950 nm and more broadly sized

attrs.text_values: 373 +/- 10 nm core and 477 +/- 54 nm HDD vs 915 nm core and 1253 nm HDD (F3 linked text)

nodes.label: Cargo loading and aptamer coating leave the rounded polyhedral ZIF-8 habit and the ~0.3 um particle size unchanged
Transverse shear in the double spiral mixes the reagents fast, so supersaturation is reached at once and nucleation outruns growth
Encapsulation efficiency is higher for the microfluidic route for every cargo (siRNA 53 vs 37%, DOX 47 vs 34%, BSA 59 vs 43%)

attrs.property_family_note: v04 has no loading/payload family; filed under surface (uptake of the cargo by the forming framework)

nodes.label: Cargo already present in the rapidly mixed stream is occluded by the nucleating framework, so more of it is trapped than in slow batch growth
The aptamer forms a phosphorus-bearing layer over the BSA@ZIF-8 surface of both aptamer types
Surface charge reverses on coating: BSA@ZIF-8 +25 mV, anti-CCL21 DNA aptamer -16 mV, A10 RNA aptamer -14.5 mV
The polyanionic aptamer backbone binds electrostatically to the cationic ZIF-8 surface, which is why no coupling chemistry is needed
Anti-CCL21 DNA aptamer-FITC-BSA@ZIF-8 accumulates in the draining inguinal and axillary lymph nodes more than the neat MOF

notes: Spine 19 nodes (judge split n2 into n2 + n22) with two result branches from the aptamer-shell node n14: lymph-node targeting (n17) and tumour targeting (n18). The biosafety claim n20 and the zeta-potential claim n15 are kept off the spine so the two-branch discipline holds; both still feed the conclusion. Lost by design: XRD, zeta, BET, reproducibility, stability, DLS of the loaded MOFs, the aptamer concentration screen, XPS P 2p and the cell-uptake work, all in Supporting Information that the packet does not carry. Packet defects. (1) F1 is the table-of-contents graphic and F2 is a journal-cover thumbnail: both carry empty captions and no OCR, so the packet's seven figures are five paper figures plus two front-matter images. (2) The F5 caption says '(B) The SEM and (C) TEM image (scale 500 nm)', but both panels are SEM fields with a 2 um bar and a TEM inset; the linked text instead assigns B to the anti-CCL21 DNA and C to the A10 RNA aptamer sample, which is what the images show. (3) The F5 caption gives the zeta potential as '+23.5 eV' (unit should be mV). (4) The F4f crop contains panels F and G, while the F4g crop carries no panel letter. (5) The F7c and F7e crops lose the row labels (time points, Reference row) that sit beside F7b and F7d, so neither crop is readable alone. (6) The F3 linked text cites 'Figure 5A-C' for acid-induced morphology breakdown and 'Figure 5D' for the zeta change, but paper Figure 5 (packet F7) is the biocompatibility figure with no SEM panels: that sentence points at a Supporting figure. (7) Packet OCR of F7b reads BUN 6.2 +/- 3 as '62+/-3'. Vocabulary note: v04 has no loading/payload property_family, so the encapsulation efficiency n12 is filed under property_family=surface with the reason in attrs.

pairs.cause: microfluidic synthesis in double-spiral mixing channels
pairs.effect: reduced average size, narrower size distribution, cubic morphology
pairs.note: the size and width half is the graph's own spine (n6 -> n11 -> n9, evidenced by o1, o2, o3). The 'cubic morphology' descriptor is not supported: o3 and n10 read a rounded polyhedral (rhombic-dodecahedral) habit and o3's image_note records that the caption's 'cubic' is not what the 1 um fields show

pairs.cause: one-step microfluidic encapsulation of BSA, siRNA and DOX
pairs.effect: cubic morphology maintained, hydrodynamic size larger than neat ZIF-8
pairs.note: the invariance half is n10 (now produced by n7 and n8), evidenced by o6 and o7. The hydrodynamic-size increase (528, 766, 722 nm) sits in Figure S7, which the packet does not carry, so it is outside the graph; and the habit is recorded as rounded polyhedral, not cubic

pairs.cause: cubic ZIF-8 structure with encapsulated biomolecules
pairs.effect: high encapsulation efficiency (~59% BSA, 53.5% siRNA, 47% DOX)
pairs.note: the graph routes the property to crystal refinement (n9) and one-pass co-injection (n7), joined at n12 with the occlusion mechanism n13. The sodalite topology and 3.4 A aperture of the MatMech reasoning are not nodes: XRD and BET are in the Supporting Information
o8 carries the +25 mV starting charge and the sign reversal; k2 is the polyanion premise; n16 is the electrostatic-adsorption mechanism that explains the aptamer layer n14

pairs.effect: controlled drug release at acidic pH
pairs.note: no node. The packet has no release curve and no acid-exposure panel: the F3 linked text points its 'Figure 5A-D' acid-breakdown sentence at a Supporting figure, while packet F7 (paper Figure 5) is the biocompatibility figure

pairs.cause: two-stage microfluidic chip integrating synthesis and aptamer functionalisation
